description.value: 88 Supermarket is a Canadian-owned Asian grocery chain that has been operating since 2008, offering an extensive selection of Asian and western foods including fresh meat, live seafood, exotic produce, dairy, and bakery items. The Kingsway location occupies a former London Drugs building, providing a large retail footprint with a wide variety of hard-to-find Asian ingredients alongside everyday staples. Cyclists riding through Vancouver's east side will find it a well-stocked resupply stop with 50+ weekly specials and a loyalty rewards program.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 17m. Total: 4 spaces.
